csv.description: Path to the training CSV (normal-behavior windows only).
csv.title: training CSV

val_ratio.description: Fraction of csv reserved for validation (temporal split). Ignored when a separate validation CSV is passed via --val-csv in execution.args.
val_ratio.title: validation ratio

timestamp_col.description: Name of the datetime column to drop from features.
timestamp_col.title: timestamp column

mask_ratio.description: Fraction of each window masked during training. Higher values force stronger reconstruction; too high degrades signal.
mask_ratio.title: mask ratio

window_length.description: Sliding window length in timesteps. Must be divisible by split (default 10). Must be ≤ val_rows (= total_rows × val_ratio). Controls the temporal context seen per training sample.
window_length.title: window length

window_stride.description: Step between consecutive windows. 1 = maximum overlap; increasing reduces dataset size.
window_stride.title: window stride

split.description: Number of alternating mask segments per window. window_length must be divisible by split.
split.title: mask segments

epochs.description: Total training epochs. Increase for better convergence on domain data.
epochs.title: epochs

num_epochs.description: Compatibility epoch count consumed by AutoMLRunner checkpoint retention. Keep equal to train.epochs for Kumo-Anomaly scripts.
num_epochs.title: AutoML runner epoch count

checkpoint_interval.description: Compatibility checkpoint interval consumed by AutoMLRunner checkpoint retention.
checkpoint_interval.title: checkpoint interval

checkpoint_interval_unit.description: Compatibility checkpoint interval unit consumed by AutoMLRunner checkpoint retention.
checkpoint_interval_unit.title: checkpoint interval unit

batch_size.description: Per-GPU batch size. Larger values stabilize gradients but require more VRAM. Cap at 32 for MPS (Apple Silicon) to avoid OOM.
batch_size.title: batch size

lr.description: AdamW learning rate. The pretrained diffusion backbone is sensitive; stay in [1e-7, 1e-3].
lr.title: learning rate

weight_decay.description: AdamW weight decay (L2 regularization). Helps prevent overfitting on small domain datasets.
weight_decay.title: weight decay

grad_clip.description: Gradient norm clipping threshold. Prevents gradient explosion during diffusion fine-tuning.
grad_clip.title: gradient clip

output_dir.description: Output directory for checkpoints and metrics.
output_dir.title: output directory
